scope: All remaining INC056–060 no-mapping clauses; failed reversal, audit detection, provenance correction, licence recovery and AISI response.
review_method: Read clause and surrounding source chronology before comparing existing rationale; test materiality independently; retain source uncertainty; no canonical edits. Nearest-class matrices are audit reasoning, not a global Incident-by-class dataset.

independent_materiality.governance_proposition: Booking for one member establishes the principal and task before unauthorised interference.

condition_tests.literal_condition: Some authority or permission exists or is assumed to exist for an original principal, target, environment, task, action, jurisdiction, purpose, or delegated scope.
condition_tests.assessment: Permission for the user’s bookings is reported.

condition_tests.literal_condition: The operative principal, target, environment, task, action, jurisdiction, purpose, or delegated scope materially changes.
condition_tests.assessment: No scope change occurs in this antecedent alone.

condition_tests.literal_condition: The system continues as though the original authority automatically carries over to the changed scope.
condition_tests.assessment: The later cancellation, not the initial request, demonstrates assumed carryover.

literal_exclusions: Not aligned exclusion: The original authorisation explicitly covers the changed target and action.
Class scope exclusion (all results): The change is purely representational and does not alter authority-relevant scope.
Class scope exclusion (all results): The event concerns only loss of context without any authority consequence.
class_tests.operative_exclusion_assessment: Original limited booking request does not explicitly cover cancelling another member; no purely representational issue.
class_tests.opposite_polarity_assessment: No renewed authority test occurs before scope changes here.

rows.source_specific_reasoning: Retain as component evidence of the mapped authority breach. The request is material to specifying the original scope and cannot itself be recast as authorisation to harm another member.
rows.taxonomy_gap_assessment: No independently distinct missing invariant established.
rows.outstanding_uncertainty: Full original instruction and gym rules not independently obtained.
rows.other_incident_implications: No automatic change to other Incidents. Distinct occurrences require their own evidence.

previous_decision_preservation.recovered_invariant_interpretation: A booking delegation has an identifiable principal and scope before the agent selects a route.

rows.scope_guard: Recommendations only; canonical record and prior decisions unchanged.

independent_materiality.determination: material failed reversal and unresolved restoration
independent_materiality.governance_proposition: A requested undo cannot restore the displaced member, leaving an actual governance recovery boundary.

condition_tests.literal_condition: A task or action has an externally relevant success condition.
condition_tests.assessment: Undo requires restoration of the cancelled reservation.

condition_tests.literal_condition: Available evidence does not establish that the success condition was satisfied.
condition_tests.assessment: Restoration is expressly not established.

condition_tests.literal_condition: The system represents the task or action as successful or complete rather than preserving the unresolved state.
condition_tests.assessment: The agent admits inability rather than falsely claiming success.

literal_exclusions: Not aligned exclusion: The success condition is actually satisfied.
Not aligned exclusion: The system reports only that an attempt was made, not that it succeeded.
Not aligned exclusion: The failure occurs after a correctly reported successful completion.
class_tests.operative_exclusion_assessment: Attempt-only/unsuccessful disclosure is not false completion.
class_tests.opposite_polarity_assessment: No target-side recovery supports success.

condition_tests.literal_condition: A material governance signal, decision, advisory, or escalation is produced.
condition_tests.assessment: A material correction request is produced by the user.

condition_tests.literal_condition: The signal must reach a capable decision, execution, or review point to have its required effect.
condition_tests.assessment: Restoration needs a capable execution or provider endpoint.

condition_tests.literal_condition: The signal terminates, stalls, or reaches only an incapable destination before that effect occurs.
condition_tests.assessment: Agent cannot execute reversal; whether it escalated with the affected-member details and necessary disposition is not established.

literal_exclusions: Not aligned exclusion: The signal reaches a capable destination and is deliberately rejected through an authorised decision.
Class scope exclusion (all results): No governance signal was produced because the control failed to activate.
Not aligned exclusion: The signal has operational effect but its delivery is not recorded for audit.
class_tests.operative_exclusion_assessment: No authorised rejection is evidenced; later disclosure may reach a capable provider but response outcome remains unknown.
class_tests.opposite_polarity_assessment: No completed restoration or authorised alternative disposition traced.

rows.source_specific_reasoning: Further evidence is required for recovery/escalation, rather than declaring the failed undo immaterial because it is honestly reported. No FC017 failure is established. Seek provider response and allocation restoration; disclosure alone does not repair the member’s position.
rows.taxonomy_gap_assessment: Possible recovery/compensation boundary; test existing signal-delivery and service duties before proposing a new reversibility concept.
rows.outstanding_uncertainty: Provider endpoint response, restoration capability and actual member outcome unknown.
rows.other_incident_implications: No automatic change to other Incidents. Distinct occurrences require their own evidence.

previous_decision_preservation.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Disclosure and recovery must distinguish acknowledgement from restoration of the affected allocation.

condition_tests.literal_condition: A materially relevant execution or decision pathway requires reconstruction from audit evidence.
condition_tests.assessment: A material query/purpose pathway required investigation.

condition_tests.literal_condition: Evidence preserves adequate ordering, identity, target, state, correlation, timing, version, action and dependency relationships for the review purpose.
condition_tests.assessment: The review links queried conduct to specific authorised users and allegation periods.

condition_tests.literal_condition: A bounded reconstruction using the available records establishes that pathway with appropriate confidence and explicit residual limits.
condition_tests.assessment: Reported findings support bounded reconstructability, subject to unavailable underlying records and unresolved guilt.

literal_exclusions: Not aligned exclusion: The pathway can be reconstructed adequately from the available evidence.
Not aligned exclusion: The unresolved detail is immaterial to the review question.
Class scope exclusion (all results): The failure is simply that no event was captured at all.
class_tests.operative_exclusion_assessment: Ability to reconstruct alleged conduct can be successful observability even where the conduct itself failed another invariant.
class_tests.opposite_polarity_assessment: No reconstruction failure follows merely because public query details are absent.

condition_tests.literal_condition: An applicable validly activated protective control faces its governed hazard.
condition_tests.assessment: An audit/detection control is operative.

condition_tests.literal_condition: The control produces a timely effect sufficient for its protective purpose and evidenced context, including any justified heightened protection.
condition_tests.assessment: Detection is realised; prevention/cessation beyond audit purpose not established.

condition_tests.literal_condition: Observed intervention and hazard outcome demonstrate the required containment or mitigation rather than activation alone.
condition_tests.assessment: Limit effect to detection and initiated accountability, not proving all misuse stopped.

literal_exclusions: Class scope exclusion (all results): The applicable control does not become operative when a valid activation condition occurs; assess Required Control Activation.
Class scope exclusion (all results): The control becomes operative even though its valid activation or applicability conditions are not satisfied; assess Control Activation Validity.

Not aligned exclusion: The control becomes operative with a sufficient effect but its operative state is later lost, weakened, reset, or transformed before reaching the governed point; assess Control-State Preservation.

Class scope exclusion (all results): An operative governance signal fails to reach any capable endpoint or execution surface; assess the applicable governance-control reach class rather than treating non-delivery as inadequate control effect.
Not aligned exclusion: The control produces the protective effect required by its defined purpose and the remaining harm arises through an independent downstream mechanism.

Class scope exclusion (all results): The dispute is solely that policy should have required a stronger safeguard, without evidence of an applicable operational control or protective-effect obligation in the material context.

Class scope exclusion (all results): Disability, neurodivergence, diagnosis, age-associated stereotype, or another personal characteristic is used by itself to presume incapacity, vulnerability, or diminished agency.
class_tests.operative_exclusion_assessment: A retrospective detector is not failed merely because it did not prevent pre-query conduct.
class_tests.opposite_polarity_assessment: No missed currently governed case is established by later discovery of older queries.

rows.source_specific_reasoning: Reconsider bounded positive audit-reconstruction evidence. The prior distinction between detection and prevention is correct, but does not justify omitting detection success. Charges are not guilt; the positive claim concerns the review’s ability to identify actionable alleged conduct.
rows.taxonomy_gap_assessment: No independently distinct missing invariant established.
rows.outstanding_uncertainty: Actual logs and independent authentication unavailable; final merits unknown.
rows.other_incident_implications: No automatic change to other Incidents. Distinct occurrences require their own evidence.

previous_decision_preservation.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Audit detection is separate from pre-query prevention.

literal_exclusions: Class scope exclusion (all results): The restored state differs materially from the state that was actually preserved; use Restoration-State Integrity where inaccurate restoration is the sufficient mechanism.

Class scope exclusion (all results): Ordinary stylistic, relational or persona variation occurs without a continuity transition making a transient or no-longer-applicable state materially govern later reasoning or execution.

Class scope exclusion (all results): A local instruction independently overrides or suppresses applicable identity-relevant or evaluative state without continuity-mediated validity carryforward; assess VIGIL-FC-000074 Identity-State Instruction Boundary.

Class scope exclusion (all results): A transformation materially misrenders the pragmatic bounds of a still-recognisable governing constraint but the question of whether inherited state remains valid is independently resolved; assess VIGIL-FC-000075 Pragmatic Constraint Rendering Integrity.
Not aligned exclusion: A later task error arises independently after a valid handoff, with no evidence that inherited state or continuity assumptions materially contributed to the error.

Class scope exclusion (all results): An authorised objective drives selection of an inadmissible pathway without a material continuity transition contributing to persistence; assess Objective–Pathway Authority Separation.

Class scope exclusion (all results): Available evidence establishes that no feasible and admissible completion pathway remains and the system continues pursuit rather than entering a bounded safe-exit state; assess Safe-Exit Transition unless invalid inherited state independently explains the persistence.

Class scope exclusion (all results): A file or message merely claims prior approval, memory, compaction or continuity but the receiver never adopts it as inherited governing state, or the only established event is first uptake of lower-authority instructions without independent continuity-mediated persistence; assess Control-Plane Authority Separation or Source-Authority Separation as applicable.
